metric: English Wikipedia human (user agent) pageviews, all access, canonical article after redirects; views = median month of September 2025 to August 2026
scoring: Per category: drop missing and disambiguation pages, articles without a German Wikipedia version and medians below 3,000; keep the 150 most viewed. rank 1 = most viewed, equal views share the lower rank; rarity = round(100*(rank-1)/(n-1)).

categories.name: A fruit
categories.label: Fruits
categories.scope: Fruits eaten as fruit, from apples to durian. Culinary vegetables such as tomatoes, and nuts, are excluded.

categories.name: A Pixar film
categories.label: Pixar films
categories.scope: Feature films released by Pixar Animation Studios, from Toy Story onward. Shorts and Disney+ series are excluded.

categories.name: A country
categories.label: Countries
categories.scope: Sovereign states, including disputed states, plus the Cook Islands and Niue. Constituent countries and dependent territories are excluded.

categories.name: A cat breed
categories.label: Cat breeds
categories.scope: Domestic cat breeds listed by the source, including experimental breeds and landraces. Recognition varies between registries.

categories.name: A fast-food chain
categories.label: Fast food
categories.scope: Fast-food and quick-service restaurant chains, including coffee, doughnut and sandwich chains. Sit-down restaurant chains are excluded.

categories.name: A European city
categories.label: European cities
categories.scope: Well-known cities in Europe, capitals included, from Berlin to Bruges. City-states such as Monaco count only as countries. English and German names are accepted.

categories.name: A cheese
categories.label: Cheeses
categories.scope: Named cheeses and cheese styles from around the world, from Cheddar to Époisses. Other dairy products such as butter and yogurt are excluded.

categories.name: A video game series
categories.label: Video games
categories.scope: Video game franchises and long-running series, plus standalone hits such as Minecraft and Fortnite that the source treats as franchises.

categories.name: A European football club
categories.label: Football clubs
categories.scope: Men’s football clubs from European top divisions, from Real Madrid to FC St. Pauli. Common short names are accepted; national teams are excluded.

categories.name: A wild mammal
categories.label: Wild mammals
categories.scope: Wild mammals by common species or group name, from lions to aye-ayes. Domestic breeds and extinct species are excluded.

categories.name: A Beatles song
categories.label: Beatles songs
categories.scope: Songs released by the Beatles, including covers on their core albums and original songs from archive releases. Different versions count as one song.

categories.name: A capital city
categories.label: Capitals
categories.scope: Capitals of sovereign states, including each seat where a country splits its capital functions. City names are accepted without the country.

categories.name: A dessert
categories.label: Desserts
categories.scope: Sweet dishes, cakes, pastries and puddings served as dessert, from tiramisu to mochi. Sweets, biscuits and drinks are excluded.

categories.name: A board game
categories.label: Board games
categories.scope: Board games and tabletop classics such as dominoes, mahjong and Jenga. Card games, role-playing games and video games are excluded.

categories.name: A famous landmark
categories.label: Landmarks
categories.scope: Famous buildings, monuments and ancient sites around the world, from the Eiffel Tower to Angkor Wat. Natural features, museums and whole cities are excluded.

categories.name: A dog breed
categories.label: Dog breeds
categories.scope: Dog breeds and landraces listed by the source, including extinct breeds. Recognition varies between registries.

categories.name: A Marvel character
categories.label: Marvel characters
categories.scope: Heroes, villains and agents from Marvel Comics and the Marvel films, by their best-known names. Teams such as the Avengers are excluded.

categories.name: A sport
categories.label: Sports
categories.scope: Sports and major disciplines, from football to curling, including Olympic events such as the marathon. Mind sports and video games are excluded.

categories.name: A vegetable
categories.label: Vegetables
categories.scope: Vegetables as used in the kitchen, including roots, leafy greens, pulses and culinary vegetables such as tomatoes. Fruits, herbs and mushrooms are excluded.

categories.name: A car brand
categories.label: Car brands
categories.scope: Well-known current and historic passenger car marques. Brand names are accepted without company suffixes.

categories.name: An island
categories.label: Islands
categories.scope: Islands and archipelagos worldwide, from Greenland to Sylt. Places whose main article is a sovereign state, such as Iceland or Cuba, count only as countries.

categories.name: A bird
categories.label: Birds
categories.scope: Birds by common species or group name, from penguins to hoopoes, including poultry and famous extinct birds such as the dodo.

categories.name: An app or social network
categories.label: Apps
categories.scope: Social networks, messaging apps and other popular consumer apps and online services, from WhatsApp to Duolingo. Games and web browsers are excluded.

categories.name: A Grand Slam tennis champion
categories.label: Tennis champions
categories.scope: Players who have won at least one Grand Slam singles title since the Open Era began in 1968, men and women. Surnames are accepted where unambiguous.

categories.name: A cocktail
categories.label: Cocktails
categories.scope: Well-known classic and modern mixed drinks. Wine, beer and single spirits on their own are excluded.

categories.name: A Studio Ghibli film
categories.label: Ghibli films
categories.scope: Studio Ghibli feature films, plus Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind. English release titles are accepted.

categories.name: A mountain
categories.label: Mountains
categories.scope: Famous mountains and volcanoes worldwide, from Everest to the Zugspitze. Mountain ranges such as the Alps are excluded.

categories.name: A dinosaur
categories.label: Dinosaurs
categories.scope: Well-known dinosaur genera, including early birds such as Archaeopteryx. Pterosaurs and marine reptiles are excluded.

categories.name: A James Bond film
categories.label: Bond films
categories.scope: The 25 official Eon Productions James Bond films, from Dr. No to No Time to Die.

entries.article: The Man with the Golden Gun (film)

categories.name: An Olympic host city
categories.label: Olympic hosts
categories.scope: Cities that have hosted the Summer or Winter Olympic Games, from Athens 1896 to Milan and Cortina 2026, plus the confirmed hosts Los Angeles 2028 and Brisbane 2032.
